parsed.why: No criminalisation, no documented targeting or universal exposure, and mildly positive official posture; but no documented acceptance, no protections, and thin visitor-facing data. Resident gaps (marriage bar, no LGR) barely count.

No presentation offence, foreign documents accepted, courts convicting attackers of trans tourists and a police officer; offset by documented continuing transphobic violence, hostile rhetoric, weak goods/services protection and detention gaps.

State-implicated police assault, arbitrary detention and degrading treatment of a trans woman (2024), discrimination statute unenforced, no recognition, hostile social climate, shadow reports document practice gaps with little relief.

Unremedied tier-1 custody exposure — birth-sex placement, isolation, strip-search, no improvement since 2010 — plus border outing and 64% discrimination prevalence, tempered by aggravating-factor law, funded care and prosecutions.

State forces documented carrying out violence, harassment and torture; eastern militias target LGBTQ people with near-total impunity; censored expression, Article 176 applied, no protections or recognition, collapsed authority.
